# Operator Note — Calibration Checks for Machining Heat Treat Furnace (see MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3)

Purpose
- Verify that temperature control and sensing systems are within acceptable limits before processing parts.

Pre-check Actions
- Confirm procedure MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3 is available at the station.
- Ensure personal protective equipment and heat-procedure-specific PPE are worn.
- Verify that safety interlocks and door seals function; do not proceed if any fault is present.

Calibration Check Sequence
- Allow the furnace to reach stable operating state per the procedure before taking readings.
- Use a calibrated, traceable reference sensor to compare against the furnace controller and embedded probes.
- Place sensors in representative locations to assess uniformity across the work zone.
- Record controller readings and reference readings in the calibration log. Note any consistent offsets or irregularities.

Acceptance and Actions
- If readings fall within acceptable variance, document completion and return the furnace to service.
- If out-of-acceptance conditions are found, tag the furnace out of service, record detailed observations, and notify maintenance and the shift supervisor immediately.
- Do not run production parts until adjustments and a follow-up verification are completed.

Documentation
- Complete the calibration checklist, attach reference device certification, and file logs per MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3.
- Note any corrective actions taken and the personnel involved.

Operator Responsibility
- Ensure accurate entries and timely reporting; calibration integrity is critical to part quality and safety.
